_doc: Ties of NPS Record of Treatment figures to catalogued Library of Congress records. A tie is written only after the figure image and the Library image were both looked at (confirmed_by_looking) and the feature matching (match_third_pass.py -> nps_figures_to_loc.json) gave at least 45 inliers and the margin of the rule; written by hand after looking.

NF-V1-p307-000.ident: image match: the figure image (extracted from the PDF, inverted to positive) matches LOC resource ppmsca.32838 (record 2012647704, Culp's Hill) with 661 inliers of 672 good matches (nps_figures_to_loc.json; first seen in a targeted check of 26 images of 15 records of the cemetery and Culp's Hill, then in the full run); both images were looked at: the lunettes, the tent at the right and the wooded hill are the same
NF-V1-p307-000.note: the figure shows the print without its mount
